notes: WhaleChat 3.77.0 — Brevo SMTP relay is now the primary mail transport (SMTP key + Brevo login) for sign-up verification codes, transactional email and receipts, with Brevo transactional SMS and OTP as the default text channel and Telesign as fallback. Admin → SMS is wired to the same provider. Offline-first chat now unions local messages into every server refresh, re-uploads the device's chat database on reconnect, and never clears an offline message. The stock trade chart draws a marker at every counted move with the profit taken and who took it (manual / Auto Secure / Take Profit), using the existing move, payout and auto-take maths.
